summary: Status page showed degraded for 4 minutes during a provider blip with no customer impact

sections.heading: Timeline
sections.body:
09:10 CDN provider reports an edge blip
09:14 provider resolves; our synthetic checks never failed

sections.heading: Impact
sections.body: None measured; the status page component turned amber automatically from the provider feed.

sections.heading: Contributing Factors
sections.body: The status page mirrors the provider's feed without our own confirmation.

sections.heading: What Went Well
sections.body: Synthetic checks stayed green throughout, which is how impact was ruled out quickly.

sections.heading: Action Items
sections.body: No action items: the provider feed mirroring is a deliberate choice reviewed in ADR-0007; revisit only if a blip ever coincides with real impact.
